description: Validate and inspect already captured public runtime-profiler evidence bundles without executing the workload.

operations.description: Human-readable validation and evidence inspection. The manifest and artifacts must be publicly fetchable with browser CORS.
Browser-executed JSON validation report with artifact digests, schema checks, identity checks, metrics, and agent guidance.

limitations: GitHub Pages cannot capture or execute workloads.
The browser validator covers the public v1 bundle contract and SHA-256 artifact integrity; native validation remains authoritative.
Reference-relative scoring requires native validation plus identical scenario and environment fingerprints; it does not define project regression policy.
A source host that blocks browser CORS cannot be inspected remotely.
